requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 140 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 140. The capacity of 18 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The future micro-nursery use and the Turin location are not used for typology or cadastral filtering. Energy class and public transport proximity are outside the reference columns.

User requires energy class C or better. Energy class C and all better classes (B, A1-A4) are included. The other requirements (Turin location, at least 140 sqm, capacity for 18 people, proximity to public transport, micro-nursery conversion) are not energy requirements and were not translated into filters.

output.explanation: Selects all columns from ESTATES filtered by the extracted requirements: surface_area >= 140, mobility >= 71, energy_class in A1–A4, B, C, the two residential property types, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance from that point, ascending. The predicates are ordered strictest first.
